title: JevBench result record
description: A public-safe benchmark result. It is intentionally not tied to StarCraft II so the same record can describe future JevBench tasks.

schema_version.description: Version of this record schema, independent of the harness version.

bench_id.description: Stable benchmark or bench-line identifier, such as LD-DG or CC-NANO.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this attempt or cited result.

track.description: One of the three JevBench publication tracks.

task.description: Task or scenario being measured; may be non-game text.

map.description: Game map or environment label when applicable. Omit for non-game tasks.

status.description: Canonical public outcome. Raw harness victory/defeat values must be normalized before publishing.

jev_via.description: Decision transport/backend label, for example openrouter or openjev.

openjev_base_url.description: Host and optional port only. Never publish a URL containing credentials, paths, query strings, or fragments.

memory_mode.description: Memory setting used by the run.

calls.description: Number of decision calls made; null when not measured or not applicable.

cost_usd.description: Measured provider cost in USD. Do not estimate missing costs.

latency_ms.description: Measured latency summary. Values are milliseconds, not a service guarantee.

metrics.description: Optional task-neutral scalar measurements. Keep values measured rather than inferred.

hq_win_evidence.description: SC2-specific objective evidence. Null or omitted for other tasks.

source.description: Provenance of the published result. Use ours only for an independently run or serviced result.

source_url.description: Citation for an official result. Do not use this field to publish secrets or private endpoints.

artifact_paths.description: Relative, public-safe paths or labels for supporting artifacts.

blocker.description: Short blocker explanation; required when status is blocked.

notes.description: Concise context and qualifications for the result.

environment.description: Optional public-safe environment labels for non-game or future benchmark tasks.
